title: The Upper Deck Vacation Rental
meta_description: The Upper Deck is a 5.00 bedroom, 3.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionTHE UPPER DECKSeacrest Beach Community105 Cobia Run West, Seacrest Beach, FL 32461Home Highlights5 bedrooms (see “Room Details” tab for configurations)3 full baths, 1 half bathSleeps 11 guests2,083 sq. ft.Fully equipped kitchen with beverage refrigerator and large pantryTwo king master suites with walk-in closets and en suite bathrooms“His and hers” themed bunk rooms on third floor: Mermaid room (3 built-in beds), Shark room (twin-over-full bunk)Queen bedroom on third floorFour 26" adult bikes included seasonally (Dec–Feb bikes not included; additional rentals available)Thoughtful storage throughout: walk-in closets, large kitchen pantry, linen closet on third floorDescriptionThe Upper Deck is a charming coastal cottage ideal for multi-family getaways. Two king master suites on the second floor provide comfort and privacy, while the third-floor features “his and hers” themed bunk rooms and a queen bedroom for extra sleeping space. The first-floor living area is bright and airy, with whitewashed décor and a stunning all-white kitchen with pearlescent backsplash—perfect for relaxing after a day at the beach.Step outside to enjoy the upper deck with classic Adirondack chairs, or explore the nearby shops and dining in Seacrest, Rosemary, and Alys Beach. The beach is just minutes away, and an outdoor shower makes rinsing off after a long day in the sand easy and convenient.Community AmenitiesSeacrest Beach offers premier coastal living with convenient access to shopping, dining, and recreation along Scenic Highway 30A:12,000 sq. ft. lagoon-style community pool with waterfalls, fountains, and multiple lounging areasPrivate community beach accessComplimentary Beach Tram service (March–October)Pedestrian paths and serene walking trailsWalking distance to Seacrest Village, Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet BeachPlease note: Golf carts are prohibited in the Seacrest Beach Community.ParkingNo designated parking for the home; nearby community lot accessible from kitchen doorOff-street parking on a first-come, first-served basis; must display valid parking permit/hangtagNo trailers allowedReservation & Booking Policies50% of total cost due at booking; balance due 60 days before arrival (or in full if within 60 days)Cancellations over 60 days before arrival are fully refundable minus 5% processing feeOptional travel insurance available; must be purchased before final paymentCheck-in: 6:00 PM CST (changing to 4:00 PM starting Jan 1, 2026) Check-out: 12:00 PM CST (changing to 10:00 AM starting Jan 1, 2026)Guests must be 25+ years old to bookNo smokingNo pets (except certified service animals with documentation)
rooms_guidance: 2nd Floor King Master Bedroom: King - Bathroom also accessible through hallway door
3rd Floor Bunk Room #1: Bunk Beds (1 Twin & 1 Full)
3rd Floor Bunk Room #2: 3 Twins - 3 built-in custom size beds perfect for the little ones
3rd Floor Queen Guest Bedroom: Queen - ***Hallway bathroom shared by all 3rd floor bedrooms
